title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Geometry (Isosceles Triangles)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The vertex angle of an isosceles triangle is $40^\circ$. What is the measure of a base angle?
questions.explain: The sum of the interior angles in any triangle is $180^\circ$. In an isosceles triangle, the two base angles are congruent. Let the measure of each base angle be $x$. The equation is $2x + 40^\circ = 180^\circ$. Subtract $40^\circ$ from both sides to get $2x = 140^\circ$. Dividing by 2 yields $x = 70^\circ$.
